documents: Copy of the bill of lading or air waybill
Copy of the passport photo and details pages
Employment Pass (front and back), issued within the last 6 months
Or Ministry of Manpower approval letter plus employer letter
Citizens and PRs: NRIC copy, plus Re-Entry Permit copy for PRs
Citizens and PRs: proof you worked outside Singapore
dutyFree: GST relief on used personal goods if claimed within 6 months of arrival
Returning citizens and PRs: GST relief after more than 6 months abroad
Without relief, 9% GST is charged on the used value of the goods
restricted: Banned: firearms, air guns, martial arts weapons, drugs and radio transmitters
Banned: chewing gum, e-cigarettes, chewing tobacco, shisha and fireworks
Alcohol must be listed in detail and pays duty, GST and a permit fee
Decorative swords and knives need a permit from the Arms and Explosives authority
Cars are strongly discouraged: very high duties and cars over 3 years old are banned
notes: You do not need to be in Singapore if paperwork is sent in advance
You can clear goods without an Employment Pass if you pay GST
Clearance usually takes 2 to 5 working days depending on shipment type
Videos and discs may be screened for a fee; list every title

documents: Copy of the passport photo page
restricted: Used batteries, especially lithium e-bike batteries, cannot be shipped by sea or air
